question.text: The interaction energy of London forces between two particles is proportional to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi>x</mi></msup></math>, where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></math> is the distance between the particles. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is :

solution.text: In London force interaction energy is inversely proportional the sixth power of the distance between two interacting particles <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>6</mn></msup></mfrac></mfenced></math>
